title: Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Extraction Kit
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired protocol parameters into the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Download the generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file generated by the software.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck layout as specified by the provided deck map.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 app to begin the extraction.
